records.text:
Q: What is HisabDo?
A: HisabDo is an offline‑first digital ledger for shopkeepers, freelancers, and small businesses to organize khata, expenses, customer records, and receivables.

records.title: Our Work | XICTEK Systems
records.text:
Q: Which technologies are used to build HisabDo?
A: HisabDo is built with Flutter, Supabase, and PostgreSQL.

records.title: Our Work | XICTEK Systems
records.text:
Q: What problem does HisabDo aim to solve?
A: It aims to make daily financial records more practical than paper registers.

records.title: Our Work | XICTEK Systems
records.text:
Q: How does HisabDo approach its design?
A: It uses offline‑first workflows, clear financial summaries, and a simple interface for everyday use.

records.title: Our Work | XICTEK Systems
records.text:
Q: What outcomes does HisabDo deliver?
A: A focused product foundation for expense tracking, digital khata, and customer balances.

records.title: About HisabDo | HisabDo
records.text:
Q: What type of app is HisabDo?
A: An offline‑first khata and ledger app designed for shopkeepers, freelancers, small businesses, and everyday users.

records.title: About HisabDo | HisabDo
records.text:
Q: What core features does HisabDo provide?
A: Customer accounts, transaction history, receivables, payables, PDF statements, and offline access.

records.title: About HisabDo | HisabDo
records.text:
Q: Which user groups can benefit from HisabDo?
A: Shopkeepers, freelancers, home‑based sellers, and new business owners.

records.title: About HisabDo | HisabDo
records.text:
Q: Do I need an internet connection to use HisabDo?
A: No, core features work offline and records stay on the device by default.

records.title: About HisabDo | HisabDo
records.text:
Q: What kind of reports can I generate in HisabDo?
A: PDF statements that show what has been paid and what remains outstanding.

records.title: About HisabDo App | HisabDo
records.text:
Q: Does HisabDo require an internet connection to work?
A: No, it works offline; optional backup or sync is available when you sign in.

records.title: About HisabDo App | HisabDo
records.text:
Q: How are records stored in HisabDo?
A: Core records are stored locally on your device; optional backup is available when signed in.
